CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: How long, O Jehovah? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long must I make decisions alone with sorrow in my heart day after day? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
Look at me! Answer me, O Jehovah my God! Light up my eyes, or else I will die.
My enemy will say: »I have overpowered him.« My opponents will rejoice because I have been shaken.
I trust your loving-kindness. My heart finds joy in your salvation.
I will sing to Jehovah for he has been good to me.
